event: The Ashcrown emerges from the boss chamber's thermal vents on a three-pulse cycle.
Tomás, who mapped the cycle on approach, calls the third pulse as the window.
Solenne's Conductor read finds every Aspect at its working register.
Nadia is in position with Pattern Break ready.
On the first pulse Dayo holds the line in full anchor posture, absorbing the impact.
On the second pulse Vesper's barriers close the Ashcrown's escape angle; Miriam holds MP.
On the third pulse Nadia's Pattern Break fractures the Ashcrown's coherence lattice.
Dayo moves into the gap and works the Ashcrown down in forty seconds.
The Ashcrown dissolves; the System awards 1,875 XP each after a 4m 28s fight.
The vents cycle down and the System logs the floor's completion.

changes.note: Floor 19 is cleared; the floors between were passed off the page

event: Dayo gives Nadia a direct, brief look and Nadia looks back.
The loot notification arrives and they continue.
The party settles in the Transition Hall above Floor 19; nobody goes to the Floor 20 Gate.
Tomás spreads his full Floor 19 map and writes up the formal record.
Vesper runs her supply cache inventory, sorting her pack in three sections.
Dayo distributes rations.
Miriam assesses the party and makes three entries in her clinical notebook.
Miriam adds a margin note about the aggro-draw technique from encounter two.
Nadia checks the dulcimer's strings and case, then puts it away without playing.
Solenne reads Brightspirit still in the fourth kind of quiet, not rebuilding the performance.
Solenne writes: 'Floor 20 door at hall's end. Not tonight.'
Solenne eats and checks her stats: RES 20, Harmonize Rank 2.
Solenne notices Vesper running thinking-mode Workframe inscriptions in a corner.
Miriam finishes her assessment, eats, and watches Vesper's inscriptions.
The hall dims and Dayo, Tomás, and Nadia go to sleep.
Solenne settles, half-asleep, the Conductor still running.
Miriam tells Vesper she did the Mana Vial tonight without being asked.
Vesper says she knew Nadia needed it.
Miriam says Vesper knew what she needed first, and asks: 'Who tracks yours?'
Vesper says she tracks whether a project is done and worked.
Miriam says that's not the same thing, and doesn't push.
Vesper says projects are how she knows she's useful, and useful is closest to secure.
Miriam says nothing to manage it and stays.
Vesper says Miriam does the same thing; Miriam says 'I know.'
Solenne falls asleep hearing the register of the conversation.
Solenne wakes in the dark hall to a notification; Miriam and Vesper are asleep.
Sanctuary Weave unlocks for Miriam and Vesper, with +7 Resonance Events: 109/150.
A second notification says all Six of Six prerequisites are met.
Solenne reads it twice and sits up.
She looks at the Floor 20 gate at the far end of the hall.
She looks over her sleeping party; Tomás has added three notes in the night.
Solenne realizes the party did something without her managing it.
She plans to tell them at Floor 20's rest floor.
Solenne puts the notification in the accessible queue and lies back down.
Solenne sleeps.
Solenne wakes to find Tomás gone ahead to scout the floor entry.
Solenne finds full HP and MP and eats.
Solenne notes Sanctuary Weave, Six of Six, and 'Tell them at the rest floor.'
Vesper goes through her finished projects and sets one item aside.
Nadia checks the dulcimer's strings in the morning light.
Vesper crosses the hall and holds out a dulcimer carrying strap made for the instrument.
Solenne gathers Vesper has been working on the strap since Floor 18.
Nadia takes the strap and studies its attachment points and carrying angle.
Nadia says 'Thank you' to Vesper, without a joke after it.
Vesper receives the thanks without deflecting, then returns to the supply cache.
Dayo, at her armor, quietly takes it in.
Tomás comes back from the floor entry.
Tomás adds one note and says the entry geometry differs from Floors 13 through 18.
Tomás does not say what he noticed, and Solenne does not ask.
Miriam closes her clinical notebook, her morning assessment done.
Nadia attaches the strap to the dulcimer case and adjusts it twice.
Nadia slings the case across her back and tests it with three steps.
Solenne says: 'Okay. Let's go.'
The party walks to Floor 20's door; the System shows full recovery and 109/150.
The door opens.
